# SRD attribution

This work includes material from the System Reference Document 5.2.1 (“SRD 5.2.1”) by Wizards of the Coast LLC, available at https://www.dndbeyond.com/srd. The SRD 5.2.1 is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License, available at https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.

Mythastria adapts this material and changes some of its rules with its own rulings, for example how stealth is rolled, and leaves others to the GM. Those changes are Mythastria's own. Mythastria is not affiliated with or endorsed by Wizards of the Coast.

The character creation catalog adapts names, numeric rules, spell identities and creation options from SRD 5.2.1. Its original selection, data structure, summaries, software and artwork are project contributions. The SRD reference is https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/srd/5.2/SRD_CC_v5.2.1.pdf.

Third-party software included locally:

- PDF.js / pdfjs-dist 5.4.296, Mozilla contributors, Apache-2.0. License: `vendor/pdfjs/LICENSE`. Official project: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js. Browser module and worker are unmodified distribution builds.
- xml-js 1.6.11, Nashwan and contributors, MIT. License: `vendor/xml-js/LICENSE`. Official project: https://github.com/nashwaan/xml-js. The browser distribution wrapper is adapted from `window` to `globalThis`, with an ESM export added; parsing code is unchanged.

No commercial rulebook data or user character sheets are bundled. Test PDFs are original synthetic fixtures.
